column1: # The 1B.5 codemod's residue: the hand edits no rule makes safely (an Io to thread, a changed signature, a removed
# std facility, a build-graph fix), one row per edit or tight group, with the step that made it and why no rule does.

column4: EGL's platform header includes windows.h, which 0.17's translate-c (Aro) cannot parse for the MSVC target; the test and exe compiles stopped there before any Zig file; a build-graph fix, not a spelling

column3: the fork's two tests: openDir/close/realpath and openDirAbsolute/deleteDirAbsolute take the Io; Dir.fd is Dir.handle; fileId reads win32_types' BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION and int BOOL
column4: realpath's 0.17 form returns a length (the expression's type changes); the removed std.os.windows struct and the BOOL enum need the fork's ABI types

column3: the two allocTmpDir tests: std.process.getenvW is std.testing.environ.getWindows, SetEnvironmentVariableW a file-level extern, allocTmpDir takes the environment
column4: removed std functions with no 1:1 spelling; an upstream signature change (allocTmpDir(alloc, environ))

column3: new: std.once's replacement (a three-state atomic; waiters yield)
column4: 0.17 removed std.once; its 6 fork callers (xdg, pty, search_controls, win32_hints) keep their call shape

column3: std.once is os/once.zig's; portable-root detection takes an Io (Io.Dir.openDirAbsolute, statFile with options, process.executableDirPath); the one-time cache lookup uses std's single-threaded Io
column4: production code: the Io must come from somewhere (the lookup can run before the global state exists); signatures change (detectPortableRoot takes the Io)
